brief: A flood-monitoring app for Mabalacat City, Pampanga: live weather, a flood outlook, community flood pins and evacuation centres. It should feel calm, clear and local, and say 'alert' without shouting.
criteria: Success: escapes the water-drop clichÃ© of flood and weather apps, reads at 16 px, works in one colour, fits the black-and-white app with one blue accent.

concepts.name: Current Alert
concepts.idea: An exclamation mark whose dot is a wave: the alert is the water.
rationale: Both halves of the name in one sign: agos (current) and alert
Built only from circles and tangent arcs; a heavier cut for 32 px and below
The blue wave rhymes with the blue dot of the wordmark

recommendation: Current Alert: ownable in a category full of water drops, instant at icon size, and on-system with the app's black, white and one blue.
next_steps: Redo the loading screen around the new mark
Trademark search before any official use
